description:
Morning After finds Rayana Jay's signature songwriting and vocals even more advanced. She penned the entire album, as she did for her debut EP, Sorry About Last Night. The project includes a lone feature from Maryland rapper Innanet James, and production from ROMderful (Soulection), Mikos Da Gawd, Elujay, Kev Choice, The Kount (Fete Records), and more.

While Sorry About Last Night ultimately detailed the turmoil of a break-up, Morning After is the clarity that comes after. The EP touches on Rayana Jay's relationship with love itself and the spectrum of feelings she experiences at the intersection of real love and loving love.

"Her songwriting has the ring of something wise beyond its years, and there's an irresistible bounce to even the most chilled-out tracks on Sorry About Last Night, her debut EP from 2016" - NPR

"Rayana Jay’s “Magic” is one of those songs you can play over and over and over again."
- Nylon

"Her music is instantly danceable R&B, with an unconventional edge: her voice bounces between melding to the grooves and breaking into its own rhythm — something like a slow, sensuous rap." - KQED
